مِيطَدَةٌ A wooden implement with which the foundations of a building &c. are compressed, in order that they may become hard. (A, L, K.) ―
-b2- A piece of wood with which a boring-instrument, or drill, is held: [i. e., a wooden socket which fits upon the top]. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
